scope: Retrospective audit only; no model inference or runtime rule changes.

assertion_provenance.source: Full42 annotation export, latest8 user clarifications, and 40-group text comparison; read-only review at 2026-10-18 03:02 UTC.
assertion_provenance.authority: Text-supported observational compatibility only, not independent video rewatch, organizer reason ground truth, or legal/policy approval.
assertion_provenance.precedence: Latest explicit clarifications supersede earlier tentative wording; the comparison is a secondary interpretation. Original AI-draft/existing-notes/manual origins remain tagged.

review_status_definition.reviewed: Prose read and a bounded sequence/state identified; other events and legal compliance remain unknown.
review_status_definition.unknown: Prose read, but a salient cause, state, category, geometry or policy question remains unresolved.

assertion_provenance.support_definition: Supported means compatible observational mechanism/proxy, subject to stated caveats; not every duration, actor role, object content or legal predicate has been independently verified.

limitations: Partial observations are transcribed from the assignment; this worker has not inspected organizer images/videos.
No cross-file cash history, appearance/position shortcuts, or timestamp adjustments are evaluation evidence.
An absent ID recognition or a few negative stills cannot establish non-presentation; adequate interval visibility is required.
Recording cutoff cannot establish future cash abandonment.
All legal/policy applicability remains pending source review under RULE_SCOPE=detector.
All 40 groups were text-reviewed; this is not complete timed event annotation coverage. Only X1 manual rows and X4 explicit clarifications supply human event times.
Clean binary labels never prove all actions compliant. Missing prose never proves absence; uncertain/occluded states stay unknown.
X2/X3 descriptions retain their ai_draft origin despite done status. Model suggestions and automatic review timestamps are not promoted into independent human event times.
X11/X12 screen state remains unknown; X35 hypothetical counterfeit and occluded detector contact are not facts.
A supported quick-visit proxy in X17 is not direct seal inspection evidence; X15 bag contents and X40 exact desk placement remain qualified.
Organizer verdicts/timestamps do not establish the reason or its legal validity.
No overall reason accuracy: human coverage is partial and causes can be unknown.
Per-file offsets never give timing credit to incompatible/unknown reasons.
API images, full API schema, and legal citations are not validated by this audit.

rule_assumptions.question: Verify transactions requiring physical ID before cash, permitted alternatives, and adequate evidence of non-presentation. Clean X19 is an applicability counterexample to investigate, not proof that ID is universally unnecessary.

Review whether each clause requires leaving the room or leaving the workstation. Walking to the safe/equipment cannot itself prove room exit; X20's document-exit finding has the wrong observed trigger.

Keep prior-session cash present at next entry separate from actual combination. New cash received beside old cash does not prove stacking/mixing, and presence-only model answers cannot establish cash owners or boxes. X4/X47 support both events, with combination time unknown.
Require a visible trigger and adequate observation interval; unknown/model failure is not absence. X43/X45 end during or after processing, so do not infer future abandonment.

Identify the actual prohibited act in X1 before evaluating a reason. The counter accepts the notes and some notes are hand-counted/returned; counterfeit, rejected-note, off-camera-check, and manual-count prohibition claims are unsupported.

Review key-left-after-exit and rejected-note recombination procedures separately. A rule about returning a rejected note to a client is not equivalent to recombining rejected notes without detector inspection; better perception alone does not implement either procedure.
Verify unattended thresholds and what closed/open/locked states actually establish. Visible closure alone cannot prove mechanical locking; a detector-supported state is not a verified legal citation.

Human account describes rejected notes recombined without detector inspection. Both candidate rules are disabled/unimplemented; their existing descriptions (whole-video manual counting/no detector, or returning notes to a client) do not directly implement that procedure.
